sources.title: Building what customers need, not just what they ask for - Linear
sources.content:
Our Customer Requests feature brings feedback from support tickets, Slack messages, and calls directly into Linear – where product and engineering teams can spot patterns, interpret needs, and build context that informs decisions.

We designed it to move beyond tallying votes for features — providing teams with concrete data to recognize patterns and build products users actually need.

Customer Requests enables teams to: [...] When product teams lack deep customer understanding, they explore paths that don’t address core customer problems. For larger companies especially, this creates significant waste — engineering resources go toward features that customers don’t need while crucial problems remain unsolved.

#### Reading between our own lines⁠ [...] The best products emerge when strong vision meets deep customer understanding. Pure customer-led development and isolated visionary thinking both fall short of consistently producing breakthrough products. Develop your product intuition by immersing yourself in customer feedback while trusting your ability to see patterns and needs they cannot articulate. Treat customer requests as input, not instructions.

Sagan Schultz
·

sources.content:

1. Integrations

# Automate your Linear workflows with AI

## Overview⁠

The Lindy.ai and Linear integration allows users to use AI to automate the creation of issues and the management of issues, projects, statuses, and users. This powerful integration allows users to automate workflows that includes Linear.

## How it works⁠ [...] When building an automated workflow in Lindy, you can add Linear actions to your workflow. This means anytime the workflow is triggered, actions in Linear can be executed with the help of AI. The actions supported today are:  
- Create issue  
- Get Issue by ID  
- Get Issue by Title  
- Get Projects  
- Get Statuses  
- Get Teams  
- Get User by Name [...] A common workflow seen is to automatically create a Linear issue every time a row is added to a Google Sheets spreadsheet, and update the sheet with the Linear link. AI can be used to fill out the issue details, or to instruct how the Linear link should be entered on the sheet.

# Connect Linear with Latenode for enhanced workflow automation

## Overview⁠

Latenode empowers you to connect Linear with various SaaS tools, enabling smooth automation of your business processes. This integration allows you to streamline issue tracking and management without needing any coding skills.

## How it works⁠ [...] ## How it works⁠

Latenode provides a visual interface for creating complex workflows. Utilize drag-and-drop functionality to connect Linear with your preferred apps, crafting scenarios that can run instantly or on a schedule. With Latenode, you can build automations from simple tasks to intricate processes, all without programming expertise.
